For [filesystem](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filesystem/).

<div class='command-title'>Drop the current idx runtime from memory.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> idx drop {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input   | output |
| ------- | ------ |
| nothing | record |
## Notes
Use this when you want to free the in-memory index completely before reinitializing it.
